# Immutable nested-rule upgrade fixtures

These synthetic bytes were captured from actual `SingBoxBaseConfigStore.Set`
and `Get` on detached Solovey v2026.3.3 commit
`3523eeea9f91c091ab3f0fbdb94c3955e37798b4`, using its unchanged go.mod/go.sum
and sing-box v1.13.18. They were not generated by candidate production code.
`manifest.json` records every SHA256, original input hash, source owner,
creation command, old store/decoder acceptance and official matcher truth table.
The temporary capture driver's SHA256 is
`20616df605d1677da3251e325004ec2ade6e247615ff5237d409a86767a097f4`.
Its exact source is preserved as `capture_test.go.txt`. Replay it only by
copying it to `service/nested_rule_capture_test.go` in a separate detached
checkout of that baseline commit, then running the manifest's command.
The candidate test suite never compiles this old capture driver.

The route/DNS AND, OR, invert and depth64 fixtures preserve domain predicates
and the explicit top-level reject action. Child actions were inactive in the
old HeadlessRule match traversal. Only these proven domain/repeat-reject shapes
may lose redundant child action keys, with an explicit upgrade diagnostic.
Conflicting actions, implicit parent actions, action-only children and the old
4096-node action-only fixture retain their bytes and require manual repair.
The latter preserves the previous 1.13 budget-test input as upgrade evidence;
the candidate budget test uses condition-bearing children for the same limit.

All source data is synthetic; no operator database or credential was captured.
